title: Mumbai's Hidden Layers
intro: Mumbai stacks centuries on top of each other. See how many you can spot.
objectives: Find something built more than 100 years ago.
Find an architectural detail most people walk past.
Find evidence of Mumbai's working life.
Find something that shows old and new Mumbai together.
Find one thing you can't explain.

title: Gothic, Mostly
intro: Fort is a dense collection of Victorian-era buildings. Read them like a book.
objectives: Find a carved animal, face or symbol on a building.
Find a tower, spire or turret and work out what it is for.
Find two buildings from different eras standing side by side.
Find an arch and note its shape.
Find a date or name carved into a building.

title: Twenty Minutes, Three Details
intro: No route. Stay within a few streets and look slowly.
objectives: Find a detail above eye level.
Find a detail below knee level.
Find something that has been repaired or patched.

title: The Working City
intro: Most of Mumbai is people at work. Watch how things get done.
objectives: Find someone carrying or delivering something and follow the journey with your eyes.
Find a tool or machine you can't name.
Find a handwritten sign.
Find a place where goods are sorted or counted.

title: Green Pockets
intro: Nature in a megacity shows up in small, stubborn ways.
objectives: Find three different leaf shapes.
Find a tree growing out of something that isn't soil.
Find an animal that is not a pigeon or a dog.
Notice a sound that is not traffic.

title: Street Canvas
intro: Art in Mumbai hangs in galleries and also lives on walls and shutters.
objectives: Find art made by a person, not a company.
Find lettering that is hand-painted.
Find a color combination you would not have chosen, and decide if it works.
Find a wall that has clearly been painted over many times.
Find a sculpture or statue and work out who or what it honors.

title: Old Stones
intro: Take your time. Look for what was here before the city you know.
objectives: Find a building that was clearly built for a different purpose than its current use.
Find a plaque, inscription or foundation stone.
Find a street or square whose name does not match what you see there.
Find a place that feels older than its surroundings.
Find evidence of the sea's old edge.
Find one thing you want to look up later.

title: Quick Past
intro: A short walk, a long time ago.
objectives: Find the oldest-looking thing in view.
Find a name carved or painted on a building.
Find something modern placed against something old.
